bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for youth boxing programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; BOXING FOR YOUTH. +]

[+$150,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to SIR Boxing to preserve Minnesota's boxing culture through youth boxing programs. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for youth boxing programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BOXING FOR YOUTH.

$150,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to SIR Boxing to preserve Minnesota's boxing culture through youth boxing programs.
additions: $150,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to SIR Boxing to preserve Minnesota's boxing culture through youth boxing programs.
